span.p:
SQLite path is a development fallback,
not an equivalent isolation boundary.

span.p:
T1 · Credential reuse
Mitigate: demo warning + lockout

span.p:
T2 · Role overreach
Mitigate: deny-by-default + SQL DENY

T3 · Aggregate inference
Mitigate: query-set and tracker rules

T4 · Downward data flow
